impact: Keep all four existing numerical ticks and add 21:35 UTC. Trading at 20:35 retains its numerical refresh opportunity; simultaneous jobs still have no completion dependency.

The 21:05 raw headline snapshot excludes earnings released at 21:30 or later. The existing due-calendar and live Zopedia research tools must acquire material reports after the snapshot; neither raw-headline completeness nor same-cycle ingestion is assumed.
Home remains four weekday runs at 14:50, 16:50, 18:50 and 21:50 UTC; only the final slot moves from 20:50 to 21:50. Every Trading slot, broker rule and authority remains unchanged.
The fifth equities tick adds numerical CPU, data-provider, publication and approved-call marking work. It starts no additional LLM research invocation and introduces no new research allowance.

Existing latest-source consumers can read the new numerical observations after publication; their pinned dataset versions do not change during a logical run. A cron offset creates no producer completion guarantee.
